name: CreateDefenseResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to view the ID of the WAF instance

WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object group. The name must be 1 to 255 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)

parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The protected objects to add to the protected object group. You can add multiple protected objects. Separate them with commas (,)

parameters.name: add_list

parameters.help_en: The description of the protected object group. The description can be up to 512 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 防护对象组描述信息。最大支持512个字符
